name: The Nameless Braves: Heaven
source:
"The Gods had but one question for mankind: what is the meaning of life?"

The Nameless Braves is a kinetic-style Visual Novel. Set in the fantasy continent of Ankh-Seah during a dour era referred to as "The Dark Age", one young man strives through trials and heartbreak to accomplish his dream of becoming a hero.

You will follow the story of Elijah, a rookie member of a mercenary organization known as "The Braves". The lands of Ankh-Seah are wrought with dangers both human and inhuman.

Elijah and his allies will be pit against the various threats that creep in the shadows of Ankh-Seah, uncovering secrets while being forced to confront harsh truths about their world and even themselves.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941750/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“诸神只向人类提出了一个问题：生命的意义是什么？”

《The Nameless Braves》是一部无分支视觉小说。故事发生在奇幻大陆Ankh-Seah一个被称作“黑暗时代”的阴郁年代。一名年轻人历经考验与心碎，努力实现成为英雄的梦想。

你将跟随Elijah的脚步展开故事。他是佣兵组织“勇士团”的新成员。Ankh-Seah大陆危机四伏，危险既来自人类，也来自非人的存在。

Elijah与盟友们将迎战潜伏在大陆阴影中的种种威胁，在揭开秘密的同时，被迫直面这个世界乃至他们自身的残酷真相。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941750/]Steam[/url]]
